title: Threat model - Document Intake & AI Summary Service (example)

flows.label: Prompt + doc text, HTTPS API key

threats.title: Customer documents sent to third-party LLM without data agreement
threats.description: Full document text including personal data leaves the tenant to the hosted LLM; spec states no data processing terms, residency or retention settings.
threats.control: Use tenant-hosted model or contract zero-retention + region pinning; redact PII before prompt; DPIA.

threats.title: Indirect prompt injection in uploaded documents hijacks summariser
threats.description: Uploaded files are untrusted input to the agent, which also holds write access to the Case DB; injected text can alter case records or summaries.
threats.control: Treat document text as data (spotlighting/delimiting); least-privilege tool scopes; no direct DB writes from model output without validation; human approval for case status changes.

threats.title: Long-lived cluster-admin token in pipeline
threats.description: Pipeline deploys with a static cluster-admin token; compromise of any pipeline job yields full cluster control.
threats.control: Workload identity federation (OIDC) with namespace-scoped deploy role; no static secrets in CI.

threats.title: Malicious file upload processed without content validation
threats.description: Intake accepts any file type up to 100 MB and passes it to parsers; malformed or weaponised files can exploit the parser or exhaust resources.
threats.control: Allow-list types, size limits, AV/CDR scan in sandbox before parse, fail closed on parser errors.

threats.title: Customer session token weaknesses at gateway
threats.description: Spec does not define token lifetime, binding or revocation for customer sessions.
threats.control: Short-lived tokens, refresh rotation, revocation list, MFA for account changes.

threats.title: Document IDs guessable across customers
threats.description: Blob paths use sequential case numbers; any service path that accepts a document ID could return another customer's file.
threats.control: Random object keys; per-request ownership check; SAS scoped to single object with short expiry.

threats.title: Poisoned pipeline execution from PR workflows
threats.description: PR builds run with the same runner and secrets as main-branch builds; unpinned third-party actions.
threats.control: Separate untrusted PR runners without secrets; pin actions by SHA; SLSA provenance + signature verification at admission.

threats.title: Vector index shared across customers
threats.description: Single index without tenant partitioning; retrieval for one case can surface another customer's content.
threats.control: Per-tenant namespaces with filter enforced server-side, not by prompt.

threats.title: Review Portal DB connection not specified
threats.description: Spec does not state how the portal authenticates to SQL or whether TLS is enforced (flow ASSUMED).
threats.control: Managed identity, TLS 1.2+, read/update stored procedures only.

threats.title: No audit trail for case changes
threats.description: Spec has no audit log for who changed a case or accepted an AI summary.
threats.control: Append-only audit table / immutable log with user and agent identity.

threats.title: Unbounded LLM consumption
threats.description: No limits on document size or tokens per job; large or adversarial uploads drive cost and throttling.
threats.control: Per-tenant quotas, max tokens per job, circuit breaker.

threats.title: Reviewers can approve AI summaries without seeing source
threats.description: UI shows summary only; over-reliance can push incorrect outcomes into the case record.
threats.control: Show source citations; require reviewer attestation; sample QA.

threats.title: Customers not told documents are AI-processed
threats.description: No notice in upload flow about AI processing or third-party transfer.
threats.control: Privacy notice and consent text at upload; record notice version.
